subject: ZenPay: Dedicated sizing workshop & calendar alignment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@zenpay.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: ZenPay: Dedicated sizing workshop & calendar alignment

Diego / Ava / Monica —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a request to lock a time for the dedicated sizing workshop:

- Current scope: live payments fraud-detection and auth enrichment (user-facing flows).
- Typical request shape: small JSON prompt + model generation of variable length. Average total tokens per request ~420 (prompt + generated).
- Traffic: baseline ~300 requests/minute during peak hours; short bursts up to ~1,100 rpm for 20–45s during load spikes.
- Latency target: p95 end-to-end response for a single request <= 1.0s (we understand this depends on model/seq length; we can discuss per-token budgets).

Attached a quick export of our 2-week load profile (zenpay-load-profile.csv). We're hoping the workshop will give Redwood enough to recommend a Dedicated GPU pool sizing and an initial autoscale policy.

Can you propose 60–90 minute slots next week for the sizing + technical deep dive? We're on PST.

Appreciate it —
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering
ZenPay
liam@zenpay.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: zenpay-load-profile.csv (CSV, 72KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@zenpay.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 12:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ZenPay: Dedicated sizing workshop & calendar alignment

Liam —

Thanks for the load export, that helps a lot. Proposed plan and next steps so we have alignment heading into the workshop:

1) Workshop goals (60–90 min): intake current traffic shape, validate token/seq distributions, agree on p95 latency target, and produce a recommended Dedicated pool configuration (GPU count, instance type, autoscale thresholds).
2) Pre-work we need from ZenPay: the CSV you attached (great), plus a filled throughput intake form (I attached a one-page PDF) with expected concurrency patterns during peak and an example of 3 representative requests.
3) Suggested slots (PST):
   - Tue Dec 7, 11:00–12:30
   - Wed Dec 8, 09:00–10:30
   - Thu Dec 9, 14:00–15:30

If none of those work, tell us a couple of windows and we'll route availability. For the workshop we'll have: me (lead for sizing and runbook), Ava (latency & benchmark validation), Monica (security + audit notes).

I've attached the intake form (zenpay-throughput-intake-form.pdf) — if you can fill and return before the session that will speed the recommendation. Also please confirm the p95 target you quoted (<= 1.0s) or share a per-token target if you prefer we reason that way.

Looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

Attachment: zenpay-throughput-intake-form.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

Subject: Re: ZenPay: Dedicated sizing workshop & calendar alignment

Diego —

Thanks, Tue Dec 7 / Wed Dec 8 / Thu Dec 9 all look possible but we want to lock something earlier in the week. Can we do Tue Dec 7 11:00–12:00 PST (60min) — that's the best for our infra lead Priya, who I've CC'd.

A few clarifications from Priya on the infra side (she asked me to pass along):
- Concurrency expectation during steady-state peak: ~50–75 concurrent in-flight requests.
- Spike profile: bursts to ~250 concurrent for short windows (20–45s).
- Token distribution: median ~180 tokens, 95th percentile ~920 tokens. Average ~420 as Diego noted.
- Desired p95 generation latency: prefer end-to-end <1.0s, but we can accept p95 per-token guidance if you recommend that for sizing.

We'll fill the intake form and return it by EOD Monday.

See you Tue 11am.

—Liam
